license_required.quote: Any person practicing or offering to practice the profession of engineering or of surveying shall be registered or exempted under this chapter. No person shall practice or offer to practice the profession of engineering or of surveying, or contract for such services, or use the initials P.E. or P.S. in connection with the person's name, or use in connection with the person's name or otherwise assume, use, or advertise any title or description tending to convey the impression that the person is a professional engineer or a professional surveyor, unless such person has been registered or exempted under this chapter.

requirements.value: The board shall register a person licensed or registered in another state, territory, possession, or DC, or who holds a government or private certification in a jurisdiction that doesn't issue a registration, in accordance with Chapter 4796. Notwithstanding 4796.05, the board shall register a person with satisfactory work experience if the person satisfies a minimum education requirement and passes an examination.

definition_quote.value: "The practice of engineering" includes any professional service, such as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, design, or inspection of construction or operation for the purpose of assuring compliance with drawings or specifications in connection with any public or privately owned public utilities, structures, buildings, machines, equipment, processes, works, or projects in the proper rendering of which the qualifications of section 4733.11 of the Revised Code are required to protect the public welfare or to safeguard life, health, or property.
